# Photosynthesis

Plants turn light energy into chemical energy (glucose).

Equation: 6CO2 + 6H2O + light -> C6H12O6 + 6O2

- Happens in the chloroplasts.
- Chlorophyll is the green pigment that absorbs light, mostly red and blue.
- Light-dependent reactions: in the thylakoid membranes, make ATP and NADPH, release O2.
- Calvin cycle (light-independent): in the stroma, uses ATP + NADPH to fix CO2 into sugar.
